widgets_values: a full-body beach portrait of a young woman standing in shallow ocean surf at sunset, photographed in a wide environmental shot from several steps away so her full figure remains visible within the larger seascape rather than filling the frame. She has a medium-to-deep warm brown complexion and long dark curly hair falling wetly around her shoulders, with a joyful, genuine smile that gives the image an open, carefree vacation energy. She wears a bikini, with the soft triangular top and fitted bottoms visible despite the backlit conditions. Her posture is relaxed and natural, with both hands lifted near her hair and chest as a small wave washes around her legs, capturing a spontaneous moment rather than a rigid pose. In the foreground, white sea foam and rippling shallow water spread across the lower frame, catching bright reflections from the low sun and creating strong near-plane texture. In the midground, the woman stands centered in the surf as the main subject, silhouetted slightly by the backlight yet still readable against the glowing water around her. In the background, layered ocean waves stretch toward a clean horizon line, while the setting sun sits low near the center of the frame beneath broad feathered clouds, filling the sky with gradients of blue, gold, orange, and soft peach. The lighting is intense backlit golden-hour sunlight, low on the horizon and highly directional, producing luminous reflections on the water, glowing edges around the subject, subdued facial detail, and a warm radiant sunset atmosphere with strong natural depth.
